label: 四合院组群
description: 生成传统四合院院落布局：外围一圈贴齐区域外边界的围墙，沿进深叠 N 个院落（进数），每个院落由横向房屋带（正房/厅堂/倒座房，贯穿院落宽度）+ 左右纵向厢房 + 环绕中庭的围廊连接而成。房屋数量=3×进数+1，进数=1 即标准四合院（4 座房屋）。输出合并多值网格、房屋网格列表、围墙网格、围廊网格与名称清单。坐标约定：x→列、y→行。
description-en: Generates a traditional Siheyuan courtyard layout: an outer wall flush with the region's outer boundary, with N courtyards (进) stacked along the depth. Each courtyard is formed by horizontal house bands (main hall / halls / reverse house, spanning the courtyard width) + left/right vertical wing rooms + a corridor ring around the open courtyard connecting them. House count = 3 x courtyards + 1; courtyards=1 is the standard Siheyuan (4 houses). Outputs a merged multi-value grid, a list of house grids, the wall grid, the corridor grid, and a name list. Coordinates: x->column, y->row.
icon: 俯视四合院平面：深色底外围一圈白色方框围墙，内部上下两条横向矩形房屋、左右两条纵向矩形房屋围出中央庭院，庭院四周一圈细线围廊，扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: region
inputs.label: 输入区域
inputs.description: 区域网格；围墙贴齐其非零包围盒的外边界（全空则用整张网格），院落布局填充其中。
inputs.description-en: Region grid; the wall is flush with the outer boundary of its non-zero bounding box (full grid if empty). The courtyard layout fills inside.

inputs.name: courtyards
inputs.label: 进数(院落数)
inputs.description: 沿进深方向的院落数量。房屋数量=3×进数+1（进数=1 即标准四合院 4 座房屋）。
inputs.description-en: Number of courtyards along the depth. House count = 3 x courtyards + 1 (courtyards=1 is the standard 4-house Siheyuan).

inputs.name: hallDepth
inputs.label: 房屋进深
inputs.description: 横向房屋带的进深（行数），默认 4；放不下时自动缩小。
inputs.description-en: Depth (rows) of the horizontal house bands. Default 4; auto-shrinks if it does not fit.

inputs.name: wingWidth
inputs.label: 厢房宽度
inputs.description: 纵向厢房的宽度（列数），默认 4；过宽时自动收窄以保留中庭。
inputs.description-en: Width (columns) of the vertical wing rooms. Default 4; auto-narrows to keep an open courtyard.

inputs.name: corridorThk
inputs.label: 围廊宽度
inputs.description: 环绕中庭的围廊宽度（格数），0=不生成围廊，默认 1。
inputs.description-en: Width of the corridor ring around the open courtyard; 0 = no corridor. Default 1.

inputs.name: gateWidth
inputs.label: 院门宽度
inputs.description: 底墙院门开口宽度（格数），0=完全封闭，默认 2。
inputs.description-en: Gate opening width in the bottom wall; 0 = fully enclosed. Default 2.

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 合并网格
outputs.description: 合并多值网格：每座房屋一个递增 id，围廊、围墙各一个独立值；可接 grid_split_by_value 拆分。
outputs.description-en: Merged multi-value grid: each house an increasing id, plus one value each for corridor and wall; pipe to grid_split_by_value.

outputs.name: houses
outputs.label: 房屋列表
outputs.description: 每座房屋一张与 region 同形状的 0/1 网格，顺序：正房→厅堂…→倒座房→各院落 西厢房/东厢房。
outputs.description-en: One 0/1 grid (same shape as region) per house, ordered main hall -> halls -> reverse house -> each courtyard's west/east wings.

outputs.name: wall
outputs.label: 围墙网格
outputs.description: 围墙 0/1 网格，贴齐外边界（含可选院门开口）。
outputs.description-en: Wall 0/1 grid, flush with the outer boundary (with the optional gate opening).

outputs.name: corridor
outputs.label: 围廊网格
outputs.description: 围廊 0/1 网格，环绕每个院落中庭一圈连接四面房屋。
outputs.description-en: Corridor 0/1 grid, ringing each courtyard to connect the surrounding houses.

outputs.name: outputNameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 名称清单 [{id,name,type}]，房屋为 type:'tile'，另含围廊/围墙条目。
outputs.description-en: Name list [{id,name,type}]; houses are type:'tile', plus corridor/wall entries.
